This is the second public release candidate of the NPMplus Security Fork. It is intended for test servers before a stable release.

### What changed since RC1

- Fixed fresh Anubis honeypot mounts, native CrowdSec conflict detection, reboot-time DNS readiness, and LAN-only administrator access.
- Simplified the installer prompts and kept Anubis's global catch-all challenge off by default so APIs, licensing servers, webhooks, and monitors continue to work.
- Added clear per-proxy-host Anubis controls while retaining per-host CrowdSec AppSec compatibility controls.
- Kept CrowdSec community blocklists enforced in the background while presenting them as useful aggregate metrics instead of a long remote-IP list.
- Reduced the frontend entry bundle from about 1.05 MB to 463 KB and lazy-loaded the CrowdSec geographic attack map.
- Hardened the optional GoAccess report with authenticated external assets, no executable inline scripts, and no-store response headers.
- Improved code-scanning alert hygiene while preserving the exact-image vulnerability gate, provenance, and SBOM publication.

### Install or update a test VM

Copy and paste the complete command:

```bash
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.2/setup-npmplus.sh &&
wget -qO setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/releases/download/v2.15.1-mangyan1.rc.2/setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sha256sum -c setup-npmplus.sh.sha256 &&
sudo bash setup-npmplus.sh
```

Choose **Install NPMplus** for a fresh test VM or **Safe update** for an existing installer-managed test VM. The update takes a snapshot, checks the complete stack, and automatically restores the previous working state if validation fails.

Please report problems through [GitHub issues](https://github.com/mangyan1/NPMplus/issues). Report security vulnerabilities privately through the repository Security page.
